title: The HPS sample size changes across 2024 cycles
caption: The nine cycles contain 610,755 respondent records. Cycle 9 has 51,280, compared with 68,544 in Cycle 1. These are survey sample sizes, not changes in the number of adults in the population.
source: Source: Census HPS 2024 respondent CSVs; measured raw row counts.

title: State unemployment rose sharply in 2020, then declined
caption: The selected states' 2020 peaks were California 16.1% (Apr); New York 16.7% (May); Texas 12.8% (Apr). The shaded area marks March–December 2020; the timing alone does not identify a causal effect.
source: Source: BLS LAUS; seasonally adjusted monthly statewide rates.

title: Hardship differs across work and household income groups
caption: In Cycle 9 (2024-08-20 to 2024-09-16), the highest displayed hardship estimate is 55.8% for Worked in last 7 days / Under $50k. Income is the prior year's household income; did not work is broader than unemployment. Error bars show 90% intervals.
source: Source: Census HPS; U.S. adults with valid responses; PWEIGHT and 80 person replicates.

title: Adults facing expense difficulty report more loneliness and anxiety
caption: In Cycle 9 (2024-08-20 to 2024-09-16), frequent loneliness is 21.0% in the harder-to-pay group versus 8.2% in the other group; frequent anxiety symptoms are 26.9% versus 9.7%. These are descriptive comparisons, with 90% intervals; they do not show that hardship caused either outcome.
source: Source: Census HPS; national weighted valid responses within each hardship group.

title: Does lower state unemployment go with less financial hardship?
caption: Across 51 jurisdictions in Cycle 9 (2024-08-20 to 2024-09-16), the descriptive Spearman rank association is 0.10. Using the midpoint month instead gives 0.13. Dashed lines are state medians, not official thresholds. Each dot is a state or D.C.; the relationship is ecological and its sampling uncertainty is not shown here.
source: Sources: Census HPS state estimates joined to BLS LAUS using state FIPS and aligned collection periods.

title: Not every state returned to its 2019 unemployment rate
caption: 21 of 51 jurisdictions had a published 2024 annual unemployment rate at or below their 2019 rate. Changes range from -2.3 to +1.4 percentage points. A recovered rate does not mean every household recovered; each state has equal weight in this histogram.
source: Source: BLS LAUS; published unadjusted annual average unemployment rates, 2019 and 2024.
